text: {"lessons":["Most months I made no trades, and short-term price moves still gave me no reliable signal about what comes next; I should act on portfolio needs, not recent performance.","Selling some Stock D after large gains reduced my exposure, but the gain versus my average cost alone does not prove it was the right time to sell; I should judge each position by its forward-looking role and risk.","My account rose overall despite a sizable interim decline, so I should keep risk diversified and sized deliberately rather than letting loss aversion push me into reactive trades."]}
